panels.title: Container memory vs limit

panels.title: RSS change over 2m
panels.description: Allocation bursts. Bars above the red line (600 MiB) are the bursts that can reach the limit from a normal baseline.

panels.title: PDU lag
panels.description: Time between a PDU's origin_server_ts and its arrival.

panels.title: Remote servers
panels.description: Servers in retry backoff or with a stale destination cache entry.

panels.title: Busy time by route (excluding sync)
panels.description: Seconds spent handling each route per second, roughly how many requests of that route are in flight. Sync is excluded because long-polling inflates it. The top entries are where optimisation pays off most.
